text: Long catch-up with Andile over coffee. His daughter Naledi graduates from Wits on 2 November 2026 and he's flying out the day before. Wants to take her somewhere nice afterwards. Ask him for photos the week after.

Kiri's twins start school in January 2027. She's already teary about it. Her husband Chris is taking that morning off work so they can both do the drop off. Their eldest, Rosa, is in year 4 now and doing a swimming gala the same week, so it's a lot. Offer to have Rosa after school that Friday.
Olivia ran the Berlin marathon last month, 3:41, very chuffed. Next up is Tokyo in March 2027. Her knee's been grumbling though, physio twice a week.
Kwame's band is playing the Lexington on 14 November 2026. He's nervous because it's their first headline slot. Must text him good luck that afternoon and go along if I can.

Caught Astrid at the school gate. Her son Luca has his grade 5 piano exam on 3 December 2026 and is practising every evening. She says he goes quiet the day before anything like that. Astrid herself is off to Oslo for her dad's 70th the week after.

Chiara and Hoang are doing three weeks in Vietnam over Christmas, flying out 19 December 2026. Hoang's grandparents haven't met Chiara yet. Long flight, 14 hours via Doha. Lend them the neck pillow. Hoang's sister Jin is getting married out there on 2 January 2027, so it's a big trip. Chiara is nervous about meeting everyone and has been learning Vietnamese on Duolingo.
Rosa mentioned her brother Reza is doing the Ironman in Cork, June 2027. He's vegan, does all his own meal prep. She thinks a decent bike computer would go down well for his birthday.
Jin's recital got cancelled, the hall flooded. Rescheduled for spring sometime, no date yet.
Quick one from the phone call with Kieran: he's moving to Lyon in February 2027 for work, Manon's going with him and they'll look for a flat the week before. He sounded stressed about the paperwork.
Joseph's lad got into the county under-14s squad. First match is Saturday 7 November 2026. Joseph's beyond proud.
Rin flew back from Seoul on Thursday, totally wiped out. Said the 13 hour flight was fine but the jet lag isn't. Check in with her next week.
Farah's daughter sits her 11+ on 12 September 2027, so they're starting tutoring in January. Farah's anxious, the kid less so.
Anil and Pooja got engaged in Lisbon over the weekend! Party planned for March 2027. Send them a card.
Book the car in for its MOT before the 28th.

Naledi Smith, Andile's girl, the one everyone calls Ledi, is moving to Cape Town after graduating. She's got a junior job lined up at an architecture firm starting 4 January 2027. Andile's a bit gutted she'll be so far away but hiding it well.

Arjun is coaching his daughter's netball team now. They've got the regional final on 21 November 2026 and he's convinced they'll lose. Plays guitar in the evenings to calm down. His wife Naledi thinks he's taking it far too seriously. The team trains Tuesdays and Thursdays and he's at every session.

Ravi and his wife are celebrating 25 years in Mauritius next spring, April 2027 probably. He wants to surprise her with a vow renewal on the beach. Don't mention it to Vanessa, she can't keep anything quiet.
Yosef's mum had her hip done on Tuesday. He's staying with her for the first week afterwards. Ring him on Friday to see how she's getting on.
Kofi is running the Great South Run on 18 October 2026, first time doing ten miles. Text him the night before. He's raising money for the hospice that looked after his granddad.
Bogdan says his son Luca passed his driving test first time yesterday. Already asking to borrow the car for a festival in Poland next summer.

Alice is in the school production of Matilda, plays Miss Trunchbull. Shows are 9 and 10 December 2026. Her mum Jen says she's word perfect but terrified of the singing bit. Get tickets for the Thursday.
Chris has gone vegetarian, apparently for good this time.
Vanessa's dog Pepper is having surgery on her leg on Monday. Vanessa's been in bits about it.

Lunch with Yetunde and Kwame. Yetunde's starting her PhD at Edinburgh in September 2027, funding came through last week. Kwame is still at the bank, hates the commute. They're thinking about Ghana for Easter, flights booked for 25 March 2027 and back the week after. Kwame's grandmother turns 90 that weekend so the whole family's flying in.
Andile asked me to drive him to the airport on 1 November 2026. Leaving at 5am, eek.
Hoang Nguyen texted, his niece just started reception and cried all through the first day. She was fine the next morning apparently.
Need to sort Olivia's leaving present, she finishes at the agency on 30 October 2026. Something running related. Jen and Rin are chipping in too.
Kiri's mum is coming over from Auckland for six weeks in December. Kiri's thrilled but the spare room is a building site.
Astrid Fischer is singing in the Messiah at St John's on 13 December 2026. Rehearsals every Tuesday until then. She's not nervous at all, says she's done it a dozen times.
Manon's sister Chiara just finished her A levels and got into Bologna for medicine. She leaves in September, Manon's flying out with her to help settle her in.

Grabbed a drink with Reza after five a side. He's off to Japan for a month in May 2027, Tokyo then Kyoto then Hokkaido. Still single, still allergic to shellfish, which he says makes Japan interesting. Wants a decent travel camera before he goes.
Don't forget Joseph's daughter's graduation is 12 July 2027. He asked if we'd come to the meal afterwards.
Farah's got her violin grade 8 next Wednesday. Hasn't played in front of anyone in years and is properly nervous. I should message her that morning.
Was meant to see Kofi's play on Saturday but the run got cancelled, the lead has covid. He was gutted.
Rosa's son Arjun has his first day at secondary school tomorrow. She bought him a blazer two sizes too big.

Pooja's training for the London Triathlon, 1 August 2027. She swims at 6am three times a week. Her partner Luca thinks she's mad. Last year she came 400th out of thousands and she wants to break three hours this time. Get her a decent swim cap as a good luck present the week before.

Kieran MacDonald, everyone calls him Kier, is in a pipe band and they're competing at the World Championships in Glasgow in August 2027. Practice four nights a week. His wife Olivia is fed up with the bagpipes.
Rin's off to Peru on 5 May 2027 for the Inca Trail with her sister Kiri. Ask her the week after she's back how it went.
Must ring Bianchi garage about the tyres.

Call with Anil this evening. His son Ravi's results came back, straight As, and he's off to Manchester to study physics. Anil's mum is coming over from Pune for the leaving party on 4 September 2027. Remind me to get Ravi a card before then.

Chidi is doing a stand up set at the Comedy Store on 26 November 2026, five minutes, first time ever. He's been rewriting jokes for weeks and is barely sleeping. His girlfriend Yetunde is dragging their whole friend group along. Message him the day before and again afterwards.
Jen's lad Kofi has his GCSE mocks in January 2027. She's worried because he's been off school a lot with his asthma.

Had a long chat with Bogdan Kowalski about his trip. He and his wife are driving to Kraków over Christmas, leaving 20 December 2026 and back on 3 January 2027. Their daughter Alice is staying here because of her nursing shifts. He wants me to keep an eye on her. Pop round to see her on Boxing Day.
Vanessa got her first half marathon medal at Cardiff on Sunday. Wants to do the full one in 2027.
Picked up the parcel, posted the passport forms, still need to book the vet for next week.
Naledi's choir is through to the national final in Birmingham, 6 March 2027. She's thrilled and terrified in equal measure. Andile and his partner are both going to watch.
Kiri's little girl lost her first tooth this morning. The tooth fairy is apparently expected to pay a fiver.

Saw Chiara Bianchi at the market. She's moving back to Turin in the spring, end of April 2027 probably. Her mum hasn't been well and she wants to be closer. Seemed tired. Ask how her mum's doing next time.
Jin Zhou's son is in a chess tournament in Hong Kong over half term, flies out 24 October 2026 with his dad. First international one. Jin's staying home with the baby.
Reminder: Yosef's daughter's bat mitzvah is on 13 March 2027. Get something for her a week before, maybe a nice pen set, Yosef mentioned she's into calligraphy.
Olivia's brother Kwame is home from Canada for a fortnight from 2 December 2026. Big family dinner the night he lands. Olivia says he's met someone over there.
Arjun texted. Passed his advanced driving thing. Celebrating with a curry Friday.
Took Mum to her appointment this morning, all fine. Then shopping, then home.

Chat with Manon after the gig. She's doing the Paris half marathon in March 2027 and her husband Joseph is doing it with her for their tenth anniversary. They fly out on the Friday, race Sunday, and stay on until Wednesday. Her cat Biscuit is going to her mum's. Check flights for the same weekend.
Pooja's sister is having a baby in February 2027. Pooja's going to be an auntie for the first time and won't stop talking about it.
Ravi struggled through the Snowdon race on Saturday, twisted his ankle near the top and limped down. On crutches for a fortnight. Drop round with some biscuits.

Kofi and Farah are off to New York for her 40th on 15 January 2027, five nights. Her first long haul flight, she's dreading it. Get her a travel kit for the plane. The surgeon said six weeks before he can run again, and he's already moaning about missing the Cardiff 10k in December.
I'm going to the Arsenal match with Chidi on 28 November 2026. Already got the tickets.

Yetunde's nephew Kwame had his graduation at Leeds yesterday. She sent a load of photos, the whole family turned out. Next he's travelling round South America for six months from January. Remember to ask her how the ceremony went.
Andile's back from the graduation. Said Naledi gave a speech and he cried through the whole thing. His knee's playing up again after all the walking.
